mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.2% indicates accelerating inflation, triggering monetary tightening and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline signal a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, HOUST growth indicates sustained consumer confidence and economic growth, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising INDPRO index reflects strong manufacturing activity, signaling economic expansion and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in rising INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A GDPC1 decline exceeding 0.5% over six months signals economic contraction, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS increases indicate aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in simultaneous CPI and FEDFUNDS rise periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, UNRATE decline below 4.0% signals labor market overheating, triggering rate hikes and negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0% in monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
